title: This 9-Year-Old Collects Old Toilets — About 40 of Them!
summary: Most 9-year-olds collect trading cards or toy cars. Damian Skaer collects toilets — about 40 of them! Damian lives in Eastern Washington. He fell in love with toilets by watching plumbers on YouTube. His dad, Roger Skaer, says Damian loves how toilets work. Damian's collection started with a couple of old toilets in his grandparents' barn. Now it has about 40, including old ones from 1965 and 1963. They stand on an 11-toilet platform his dad built, and every toilet can really flush. Damian shares his collection on TikTok and Instagram, where hundreds of thousands of people watch his videos. Skilled trades like plumbing need more young workers. A 2026 survey found only 6 percent of young adults ages 18 to 25 planned to work in the construction trades. The group Bring Back the Trades says more than 1.4 million trade jobs will be empty in 2030. Damian says he wants to be a plumber. His dad thinks he might become a toilet designer. Damian has been asking for a 3D printer so he can build his own toilets.
why_it_matters: It shows that a hobby you love can grow into a real job one day.

keywords.explanation: Plumbers are workers who fix and set up pipes, sinks, and toilets.
A platform is a flat raised place where things are put on show.

A 3D printer is a machine that builds real objects from a computer design.
